summary: Normalizes the input string via sub_589901, then walks a linked list of named string nodes returning the first node whose name compares equal to the normalized input. The per-node flag at +0x9C bit 0x200 selects wide-character vs narrow-character string layout. Returns the matching node pointer, or 0 when the list is empty or the name is not found.

Traverse the node linked list via the next-node pointer stored at node offset +0xC0, stopping when it becomes null.
Per-node guard: flag at node offset +0x9C with bit 0x200 set selects the wide-character name path; otherwise the narrow-character path is used.
Copy the current node's name string into the local nodeNameBuffer, byte-by-byte (wide or narrow per the flag), then append a null terminator in the wide-character path.
Compare the normalized needle (SrcStr) against the node name byte-by-byte, producing compareResult v10: -1 if less, +1 if greater, 0 if equal.
Return the current node pointer when the comparison result is 0 (name match).
Advance currentNode to the next node via the next pointer at node offset +0xC0.
Return 0 when the next-node pointer is null (end of list, no match found).
